notes: Request-side: the spec's "Logprobs" example request (include[]=logprobs). include is not forwarded, so the answer is the plain json of transcription_json, not the example's logprobs. Recordable with real audio. The upload, audio.mp3, is 3.2 s of English speech ("The beach was a popular spot on a hot summer day.") generated for this suite with espeak-ng 1.51 (voice en-us, 165 words a minute) and encoded with ffmpeg (libmp3lame, 16 kHz mono, 24 kbit/s, metadata stripped, bit-exact): synthetic, so free of licence terms. The same file is in every case that names it; a real recording of a person may replace it.
